args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted, 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08).
All three final checks pass on every run: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections. The width-free ratio was not used in any run.
The centre REGR peak is at 421 µm in every run. Growth-zone lengths are 674–695 µm, and the largest flank differences are -7.97 to -8.36 %/h, at 410–432 µm.
Some |z| values are large only because the batch MAD is very small. r03's REGR peak (51.66 %/h) is 1.4 %/h (about 2.6 %) below the median, and r06's largest flank difference is about 0.3 %/h larger than the median. Both look like normal differences between roots.
r04 kept one remedy: frames were registered on non-growing tissue from 400 px from the tip. All its checks pass, and its velocity and strain-rate profile matches the batch.
No runs were flagged, so there is nothing they share.
To note: some runs have identical checks and summaries. r01 matches r05, and r02, r07 and r08 all match each other, even though r08 took 5 steps. Please confirm these are separate roots or time windows and not repeated runs of the same movie.
